guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Unpackaged dry cargo such as grain, coal and minerals.
guide.Distinctive features: Large cargo holds and hatch covers; geared and gearless versions. Common size families include Handysize, Supramax, Panamax and Capesize.

photo_credit.author: Superfast1111
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Dense mineral cargo, particularly iron ore.
guide.Distinctive features: Hold and hull arrangements are designed for heavy cargo; available cargo weight and structural loading limits govern stowage.

photo_credit.author: US Army Corps of Engineers, photo by Jerry Bielicki
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: USEPA GL collection 151 DuluthHalletDockSelfunloader.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Dry bulk deliveries where dedicated shore unloading equipment is limited.
guide.Distinctive features: Onboard conveyors and a discharge boom transfer cargo to shore or another vessel; unloading equipment varies by design.

photo_credit.author: DmitTrix
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Bulk cement and similar dry powder products.
guide.Distinctive features: Enclosed cargo spaces and pneumatic handling are common; dust control and protection from moisture are important.

photo_credit.author: Gary Houston
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Tarakan-Express-Burnie-20150420-001.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Woodchips for pulp and paper production.
guide.Distinctive features: High-volume holds suit low-density cargo; grab cranes and conveyors are common handling equipment.

photo_credit.author: Luis Alfredo Romero
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Cargo Ship Puerto Cortes.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Bagged, palletised and unpackaged individual cargo items.
guide.Distinctive features: Flexible holds for mixed cargo; ship or shore cranes handle individual pieces. Some designs have intermediate decks.

photo_credit.author: Farid mernissi
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Navire NETBURG à quai.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Different combinations of general cargo, containers and project cargo.
guide.Distinctive features: Adaptable holds and deck arrangements; cranes and removable intermediate decks depend on the vessel configuration.

photo_credit.author: kees torn
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: MAERSK MC KINNEY MÖLLER & MARSEILLE MAERSK (48694054418).jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Standardised freight containers, including refrigerated units where connections are available.
guide.Distinctive features: Container guides and securing systems organise stowage; capacity is commonly stated in TEU, not cargo tonnes alone.

photo_credit.author: Niels Johannes
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Lombok Strait.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Temperature-sensitive food such as fruit, meat and fish.
guide.Distinctive features: Insulated, temperature-controlled holds maintain the cargo environment; ventilation and temperature settings depend on the product.

photo_credit.author: John Coppi, CSIRO
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: CSIRO ScienceImage 4345 Livestock transport at Port Adelaide South Australia 1995.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Live animals on dedicated sea transport voyages.
guide.Distinctive features: Animal pens, ventilation, feed and water systems; space and care requirements depend on animal type and voyage.

photo_credit.author: WindBorneListener
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: MV Happy Star.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Large machinery, industrial modules and other oversized project cargo.
guide.Distinctive features: Strengthened cargo areas and heavy-duty cranes on geared versions; lifting limits depend on radius and configuration.

photo_credit.author: U.S. Navy/Journalist 2nd Class Ryan C. McGinley
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Floating structures, large vessels and offshore units.
guide.Distinctive features: Ballast tanks lower the cargo deck for float-on loading; the vessel then raises the deck for transport.

photo_credit.author: Tim Green
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Hartland Point Ro-Ro Cargo Ship, IMO 9248538.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Trucks, trailers and other wheeled cargo.
guide.Distinctive features: Cargo rolls through ramps onto vehicle decks. Lane metres and deck loading limits matter alongside payload.

photo_credit.author: FPTI
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Car carrier vessel LIBERTY PEACE, sailing in the Puget Sound (20240219).jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Vehicles carried on multiple enclosed decks.
guide.Distinctive features: Vehicle ramps and closely spaced decks; PCTC designs may include adjustable decks for taller trucks and machinery.

photo_credit.author: Tvabutzku1234
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: ConRo ship Atlantic Compass.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Containers and wheeled cargo on the same vessel.
guide.Distinctive features: Combines container stowage with Ro-Ro decks; cranes handle containers and ramps handle vehicles.

photo_credit.author: Kevin H. Tierney / U.S. Navy
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Supertanker AbQaiq.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Unrefined petroleum between production areas and refineries.
guide.Distinctive features: Liquid cargo tanks, pumps and piping; common size descriptions include Aframax, Suezmax and VLCC.

photo_credit.author: Gordon Leggett
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: 2022-09-04 01 ACADIAN - IMO 9298715 tanker – St. John’s NL Canada.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Refined petroleum products such as diesel and gasoline.
guide.Distinctive features: Separated tanks and cargo systems support different product parcels; tank cleanliness and product compatibility are important.

photo_credit.author: Niels Johannes
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Ursula Essberger 2018.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Liquid chemicals and compatible specialised liquid cargo.
guide.Distinctive features: Separate tanks, specialised coatings or stainless steel and segregated pipework depend on the substances carried.

photo_credit.author: Pline
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Methanier aspher LNGRIVERS.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Natural gas transported in liquid form at cryogenic temperature.
guide.Distinctive features: Highly insulated containment systems; membrane and independent tank designs are used. Cargo volume is normally stated in cubic metres.

photo_credit.author: Ilkka Simomaa
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: LPG tanker Run Far in waters off Peng Chau, Hong Kong 2019-10-22.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Liquefied gases such as propane and butane.
guide.Distinctive features: Pressurised, semi-refrigerated or fully refrigerated arrangements; tank conditions are matched to the cargo.

photo_credit.author: Alfvanbeem
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Iver Brilliant (ship, 2012) IMO 9616761, MMSI 244308000) Bitumen Tanker arriving at Europoort.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Bitumen and other suitable viscous hot cargoes.
guide.Distinctive features: Heated and insulated tanks and piping keep cargo pumpable; required temperature depends on the product.

photo_credit.author: Marc Ryckaert
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Bunkering Tanker on the Nile R03.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Marine fuel delivered to other vessels.
guide.Distinctive features: Cargo tanks, transfer pumps and hoses support ship-to-ship fuel delivery; tanker or barge configurations are used.

photo_credit.author: FrogsLegs71
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: DFDS Transmanche Ferry loading at Newhaven Harbour.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Regular passenger crossings; some designs also carry vehicles.
guide.Distinctive features: Designed around route length and terminal access; vehicle ferries use loading ramps and dedicated vehicle spaces.

photo_credit.author: kallerna
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Viking Grace Ruissalo 4.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Passengers together with cars, trucks and trailers.
guide.Distinctive features: Combines passenger accommodation with Ro-Ro decks; capacity is described separately for passengers and vehicles.

photo_credit.author: Corey Seeman
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Icon of the Seas Puerto Rico 2025 (cropped).jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Leisure voyages with accommodation and visits to multiple destinations.
guide.Distinctive features: Cabins, dining and leisure spaces distinguish it from a simple transport ferry; passenger capacity is vessel-specific.

photo_credit.author: Remi Jouan
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: SpeedOne (1).JPG

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Fast passenger services, with vehicle capacity on some designs.
guide.Distinctive features: Includes catamarans, hydrofoils and other high-speed forms; operating limits depend on design and route.

photo_credit.author: Diliff
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Barge on River Thames, London - Dec 2009.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Cargo, equipment or floating work platforms.
guide.Distinctive features: Broad, shallow hull; many rely on tugs or pushboats. Open, covered and flat-deck versions serve different cargoes.

photo_credit.author: GuavaTrain
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Tugboat Crosby Skipper.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Assisting ships during manoeuvres and towing operations.
guide.Distinctive features: Compact hull with powerful propulsion and towing gear; bollard pull is a key measure, distinct from engine power.

photo_credit.author: Wikideas1
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Tow boat La Crosse.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Moving barges in inland waterways.
guide.Distinctive features: Pushes a coupled barge formation from behind; the barge carries the cargo and the pushboat supplies propulsion.

photo_credit.author: Marc Ryckaert
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Pallieter Hopper Dredger R04.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Removing seabed material for channels, ports and reclamation work.
guide.Distinctive features: Main types include trailing suction hopper, cutter suction and mechanical dredgers; equipment is selected for the ground material.

photo_credit.author: Marc Ryckaert
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Tiger Split Hopper Barge R01.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Transporting dredged sand, silt and similar material.
guide.Distinctive features: A central hopper carries material; bottom doors or a split hull may discharge it at the authorised location.

photo_credit.author: Norbert Kaiser
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Warnemünde Handelsschiff (01) 2006-09-21.JPG

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Short-sea and regional cargo transport.
guide.Distinctive features: Usually smaller cargo vessels suited to coastal ports; draught and air draught may be decisive route constraints.

photo_credit.author: Alf van Beem
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Thialf (ship, 1985) leaving Port of Rotterdam photo 1.JPG

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Lifting heavy structures for marine construction.
guide.Distinctive features: Large fixed or rotating cranes; rated lift depends on outreach, operating conditions and crane arrangement.

photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Port Side of CS Cable Innovator.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Installing and repairing subsea power and communication cables.
guide.Distinctive features: Cable storage and controlled payout equipment; positioning and cable handling are central to the operation.

photo_credit.author: PR Allseas
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Allseas' Solitaire, pijplegschip.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Installing subsea pipelines.
guide.Distinctive features: Pipe joining, tension control and overboarding systems; S-lay, J-lay and reel-lay are different installation methods.

guide.Distinctive features: Open cargo deck plus tanks for suitable liquids and dry bulk; deck area and cargo tank volumes describe capability.

photo_credit.author: BoH
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Normand Master.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Handling offshore anchors, towing and supply duties.
guide.Distinctive features: Powerful winches and working deck; towing and anchor loads distinguish this type from an ordinary supply vessel.

photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Distinctive features: Heavy lifting and component storage; jack-up versions use seabed-supported legs to raise the working platform.

photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Offshore well drilling or scientific deep drilling.
guide.Distinctive features: Drilling derrick and drill handling systems; station keeping and drilling equipment are tailored to water depth and task.

photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Processing and storing offshore production before transfer to tankers.
guide.Distinctive features: Combines process equipment with storage tanks and offloading systems; usually stationed at a production field.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Oceanography, hydrographic surveying and marine sampling.
guide.Distinctive features: Laboratories, sensors and sampling gear are configured for the mission; survey and research variants differ.

photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: 120106-G-IA651-272 (6668116881).jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Opening routes through ice and supporting polar operations.
guide.Distinctive features: Reinforced hull and ice-capable propulsion; capability depends on ice conditions and the vessel's design.

guide.Distinctive features: Trawlers, longliners, purse seiners and pot vessels use different gear; catch storage and handling depend on the fishery.

guide.Distinctive features: Combines fish handling and processing machinery with cold storage; processing throughput differs from cargo storage capacity.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Transferring marine pilots between shore and ships.
guide.Distinctive features: Manoeuvrable hull, protective fendering and transfer access; designed for boarding operations near moving ships.

photo_credit.title: Lifeboat.17-31.underway.arp.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Rescuing people and assisting vessels in distress.
guide.Distinctive features: Recovery equipment, survivor space and communications; offshore and coastal rescue designs serve different conditions.

photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Firefighting on vessels, waterfronts and port facilities.
guide.Distinctive features: Water pumps and fire monitors deliver extinguishing streams; equipment and foam capability vary by vessel.

photo_credit.author: Myrabella
photo_credit.changes: Resized and converted to WebP; no content changes.
photo_credit.title: Lady Lau super-yacht IMO 1010674 Bonifacio.jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Private leisure voyages or charter services.
guide.Distinctive features: Motor propulsion, accommodation and leisure spaces; layout and passenger limits are specific to each yacht.

guide.Distinctive features: Masts, sails and rigging provide wind propulsion; many ships also have auxiliary engines.

photo_credit.title: Italian frigate Federico Martinengo (F 596).jpg

guide.Typical cargo / purpose: Patrol, defence, support and other naval missions.
guide.Distinctive features: Includes patrol vessels, corvettes, frigates, destroyers and support ships; equipment varies by mission and class.
